parties.ourParty: 551 FX IB Associates, LLC (Licensee — our client)
parties.counterparty: SFG Financial Corp, a/k/a E-Path FX (Licensor)

plans.note: All-caps disclaimer block in Article VIX is the natural home for a consequential-damages waiver and liability cap; check General Provisions for any stray cap language. Confirm mutuality and carve-outs (IP infringement, confidentiality, gross negligence).

No indemnity heading appears in the outline; a licensor IP indemnity is likely missing entirely and should be added, paired with the Article VIX disclaimer. Also verify no one-way Licensee indemnity is buried in General Provisions.

License Grant and Restrictions (Article II) and the confidentiality/non-solicitation article are the likely spots for covenants limiting our platforms or competing products; check Article VIII for restraint language tied to the Right of First Refusal.
The defined term 'Right of First Refusal' signals an exclusivity or first-look obligation on us; trace its definition in Article I and its operative use in Article VIII and the license restrictions.
Check the fee tiers and Article VIII (Supplemental Payments / Right of First Refusal) for any best-terms undertaking running against us; MFN in our favour would be acceptable, the reverse is not.
Article X is captioned 'Confidential Information/Non Solicitation' — review scope, duration, mutuality and whether a general-advertising / unsolicited-applicant carve-out exists.

Term and termination mechanics most likely sit in Article VIII alongside the 'Initial Period' definition in Article I; confirm we have convenience termination on notice and that Licensor cannot exit mid-term or terminate the licence at will.
'Initial Period' is a defined term, so check Article I and Article VIII for auto-renewal, notice window and any uncapped price escalation on renewal.

Governing law, venue and any dispute-resolution/arbitration clause should sit in the General Provisions article (XXIV); confirm New York or another accepted forum and courts rather than offshore arbitration.

Assignment and successors language belongs in General Provisions; check for a consent requirement on our side, affiliate/successor carve-out, and any Licensor termination right on our change of control.

Definitions of Derivative Work, Intellectual Property Rights, Moral Rights and Licensed Technology plus Article II restrictions will determine ownership; ensure our data, feedback and customer information are not swept into Licensor ownership.

Article II grant plus the Article I definitions of Field of Use, Affiliate, Platform Software and Documentation; check that the grant extends to our affiliates and contractors and is not revocable at Licensor's discretion.
Usage-verification or records-inspection rights typically ride with the licence restrictions or General Provisions; if present, tighten to annual, notified, off-site and at Licensor's cost.
Review the per-transaction fee tiers and 'Supplemental Payments' mechanics for shortfall charges, penalties or accelerated fees payable by us on early exit or low volume.

Article VIX is a broad all-caps warranty disclaimer (merchantability, non-infringement, fitness, no error correction); we need an affirmative performance/documentation warranty with a repair-or-refund remedy carved out of the disclaimer.
No insurance heading in the outline; given Licensor hosts the trading platform and touches our data, propose standard coverages (commercial general, tech E&O/cyber) in General Provisions.

The volume-based US$ per-unit tiers plus 'Market Day' and 'Supplemental Payments' definitions suggest a minimum-volume or take-or-pay construct; confirm whether any floor is committed and secure an exit if so.
No wind-down heading is visible; check the termination provisions in Article VIII for effects-of-termination language and, if absent, add data return/deletion and transition assistance obligations.
